evidence.Medial Meniscus: Oblique undersurface tear of the posterior horn.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Complex tear of the lateral meniscus with a dominant horizontal component and mild extrusion of the body.
evidence.Medial OA: Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.
evidence.Lateral OA: Mild lateral and moderate patellofemoral compartment chondrosis.
evidence.PF OA: Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Moderate chondrosis, with diffuse high-grade partial-thickness cartilage loss and areas of full-thickness fissuring in the medial patellar facet
evidence.Synovitis: 3 cm hypointense lesion in the posterior joint capsule, with features consistent with PVNS.
evidence.Contusion: No acute fracture or bone bruise.
evidence.Fracture: No acute fracture or bone bruise.
